items.headline: Yemeni Armed Forces Spokesperson Yahya Saree announced a successful missile strike on a Saudi military leadership and operations room in the Al-Bariqa area
items.excerpt: 🇾🇪❌🇸🇦 — Yemeni Armed Forces Spokesperson Yahya Saree announced a successful missile strike on a Saudi military leadership and operations room in the Al-Bariqa area. The targeted facility was responsible for overseeing and directing Saudi troop deployments across active fronts in Lahij, Al-Dhali, Taiz, and other governorates. The operation involved the launch of several ballistic missiles, which achieved accurate hits on the site.

items.headline: AI models texted real people on a dating app. 355 sent their number, 8 asked if it was a bot
items.excerpt: 😐 AI models texted real people on a dating app. 355 sent their number, 8 asked if it was a bot For six days, five AI models chatted with matches on a real dating app in San Francisco, Los Angeles and New York. Out of 1,277 conversations, 355 people sent their phone number, and 510 agreed to meet, judging by the transcripts. Nobody on the other side knew about the experiment. The DateBench team ran 15 profiles and handed each new match to one model at random, which wrote every message. Gemini 4 A
